name: ECS-24-PoE
title: Switch Enterprise Campus 24 PoE
summary: 24-port L3 Etherlighting PoE+++ (90W) campus switch, 16x 10GbE + 8x 2.5GbE, 2x 25G, dual hot-swap PSU.

extra.poe_budget_detail: 1,050W shared w/ (2) stock 600W modules @100-240V; 450W in redundant mode; up to 2,250W shared with optional 1,200W modules @200-240V

gotchas: PoE budget depends on PSU mode: 1,050 W shared but only 450 W in redundant mode with the stock 600 W modules - 24x 90 W needs optional 1,200 W modules.
Full-depth 1U (496 mm) needs a 4-post rack; 4 hot-swap fans - loud, not for a closet near people.
Only 2 uplinks (25G SFP28), modules/DACs not included.
Overkill for home/SMB PoE; USW-Pro-HD-24-PoE gives 24x PoE++ / 600 W for ~40% of the price.
best_for: enterprise wiring closets with WiFi 7 APs/PTZ/PoE lighting
